evidence_policy: A behavior-changing claim requires two independent current-era strategy sources or one credible current strategy source plus repository confirmation; historical SQL/hotfix values remain repository or historical evidence only, and conflicts remain unresolved.
fidelity_policy: Do not promote guide-reported values, historical hotfixes, or local implementation timers to 4.4.2 retail invariants without frozen client data or live evidence.

tanks: two tanks for phases 1 and 2, one tank for phase 3
keep active councilors close for cleave while moving from telegraphed hazards
drag Monstrosity around the edge out of Liquid Ice
healers: pre-heal Glaciate, Aegis/Rising Flames, Quake/Thundershock and Gravity Crush targets
prioritize Gravity Crush victims for the full 6.5s channel
rotate raid cooldowns for phase-three Electric Instability and Liquid Ice damage
phase_one_raid: clear Waterlogged in Inferno Rush fire before Glaciate
spread for Water Bomb and Inferno Leap
spread Heart of Ice and Burning Blood imbues before dispel
phase_two_raid: isolate Lightning Rod targets by at least 15yd
move from Eruption and break Harden Skin
on heroic pair Static Overload and Gravity Core carriers
phase_three_raid: spread ranged groups for Electric Instability
leave melee range while Monstrosity is trapped over Liquid Ice
heroic: kite Frozen Orb into Flame Strike fire
avoid Flame Strike impact and lingering fire
clear Static Overload and Gravity Core by meeting carriers away from raid

phases.name: feludius_ignacious
phases.transition_trigger: either active councilor reaches 25 percent health
phases.repository_control: DamageTaken calls ACTION_SWITCH_COUNCILLORS and clamps lethal damage so councilors survive at 1 HP
phases.guide_behavior: current guides describe both bosses teleporting away when one reaches 25 percent

phases.name: arion_terrastra
phases.transition_trigger: either active councilor reaches 25 percent health
phases.repository_control: DamageTaken calls ACTION_UNITE_COUNCILLORS and clamps lethal damage so all four remain for merge
phases.guide_behavior: current guides describe the same 25 percent transition and balancing requirement

phases.name: elementium_monstrosity
phases.transition_trigger: controller schedules merge 14.5s after phase-two unite
phases.repository_control: Merge Health 82344 sums current health of Feludius, Ignacious, Arion, and Terrastra, then Elementium Monstrosity uses the sum
phases.guide_behavior: all four remaining health pools combine; Electric Instability and Liquid Ice create a soft enrage

mechanics.summary: Random non-tank Frost cast that must be interrupted.
conflicts: Wowhead narrative and ability table disagree on damage; guide cadence differs from local event schedule.

mechanics.summary: Water Bomb damages units within 6yd and applies Waterlogged; fire from Inferno Rush clears it before Glaciate. Glaciate damage falls with distance and freezes Waterlogged targets.
conflicts: Exact Water Bomb count/target selection is in server-side spell/condition data rather than the C++ event code; local preparation cadence differs from guide cadence.

mechanics.summary: Random non-tank increasing Frost periodic debuff that grants nearby Frost Imbued; dispel after spreading.
conflicts: Guide interval and exact aura growth/duration are not reconciled with local script/DBC.

mechanics.summary: Frontal fire cone that must face away from the raid.
conflicts: Guide and local cadence differ; exact damage is guide-reported only.

mechanics.summary: Leap to a distant/random ranged target, knock nearby players back, and leave a fire path on return; fire clears Waterlogged.
conflicts: Current Classic bug reports describe missing fire trails; exact Classic path reliability is unresolved.

mechanics.summary: Aegis shields Ignacious and makes him interruption-immune while Rising Flames channels raid-wide fire damage; break shield and interrupt channel.
conflicts: Guide cadence and local event schedule differ; exact shield/channel coefficients are DBC/build-dependent.

mechanics.summary: Random non-tank increasing Fire periodic debuff that spreads Flame Imbued to nearby allies and empowers attacks against Feludius.
conflicts: Timer and exact aura duration/growth are unresolved.

mechanics.summary: Opposite elemental imbues double damage to the corresponding councilor locally; either active councilor crossing 25% starts the teleport swap and both active councilors are protected from death.
mechanics.confidence: threshold_and_local_control_confirmed; retail damage multiplier and exact transition timing blocked

mechanics.summary: Call Winds creates a moving cyclone; touching it grants Swirling Winds needed to mitigate Quake.
conflicts: Local helper does not encode the guide-reported 50s lifetime.

mechanics.summary: Lightning Rod marks players for delayed Chain Lightning; marked players must isolate from the raid.
conflicts: Current Wowhead prose says three players without a clear 10/25 mapping; local uses raid-size mapping.

mechanics.summary: Disperse teleports Arion away, then Lightning Blast targets his victim and must be interrupted.
conflicts: Guide and local cadence/cast pipeline differ; local target stalker selection requires DB conditions.

mechanics.summary: Thundershock is raid-wide; Grounded from Gravity Well reduces it locally by 99%.
conflicts: Local warning/cast schedule is not independently confirmed by current guides.

mechanics.summary: Gravity Well creates a pull zone and Grounded; Grounded is needed for Thundershock and cancels Swirling Winds.

values.buff_exclusion: local Gravity Well removes Swirling Winds

conflicts: Guide and local cadence differ; exact pull/aura durations are spell-data dependent.

mechanics.summary: Five local spike targets erupt around Terrastra, dealing area Physical damage and knocking players up; move the melee group.
conflicts: Guide and local event cadence differ.

mechanics.summary: Interrupt Harden Skin; if it lands, Terrastra gains a damage-absorbing shield and physical damage increase until broken, then Shatter returns accumulated absorbed damage locally.
conflicts: Icy Veins omits cadence; local DBC amount is percentage-based and the local timer differs materially from Wowhead.

mechanics.summary: Quake hits non-Swirling-Winds targets locally; obtain Swirling Winds from a cyclone before the cast.
conflicts: Guide and local cadence differ; exact local spell reduction is target filtering rather than a numeric 90% modifier.

mechanics.summary: Inactive Arion/Terrastra assist on heroic; each selects one target while excluding carriers of the opposite debuff. The two carriers meet away from the raid to clear both auras.
conflicts: Exact current heroic coefficients/durations and phase-relative schedule are unresolved.

mechanics.summary: Inactive Feludius pursues a random player with Frozen Orb; inactive Ignacious targets Flame Strike fire. Guide strategy is to kite the orb through lingering fire to remove it.
conflicts: Local timer/trigger pipeline and current guide prose do not establish exact wipe/expiry behavior for 4.4.2.

mechanics.summary: At 25% of Arion or Terrastra, all four councilors enter the merge RP; Elementium Monstrosity receives the sum of their remaining health.

values.repository_clamp: each councilor survives at health-1 until despawn

conflicts: The guide rule is qualitative; exact current Merge Health spell effects and client state are not validated.

mechanics.summary: Cryogenic Aura creates/scales Liquid Ice under the boss; the pool expands while the boss remains in it and creates a damage race.
conflicts: Historical Blizzard hotfix reverted a Liquid Ice damage increase because of hitbox/avoidance issues; no 4.4.2-specific coefficient proof is available.

mechanics.summary: Every-second Nature chain that ramps the number of selected targets and pressures spread ranged groups.
conflicts: Current guide says more targets over time but does not specify cap; exact mode coefficient is not validated.

mechanics.summary: Random floor kernels erupt after a warning and must be avoided.
conflicts: Local plume timing and guide explosion timing are different stages; exact mode damage is guide-reported.

mechanics.summary: Gravity bubble removes the current tank from selection locally, lifts targets, and applies 9% maximum-health damage every 0.5s for 6.5s.
conflicts: Both current guides say three targets, while local target filtering maps count by raid size (one in 10-player, three in 25-player).

reset_and_credit.reset: Controller Reset schedules EVENT_RESET_BOSS_STATE after 1ms unless boss is DONE; that event sets NOT_STARTED and summons all four councilors.
reset_and_credit.evade: ACTION_STOP_ENCOUNTER disengages/despawns four councilors and Monstrosity, removes four player helper auras, marks FAIL, resets events/phase, and schedules fresh summons after 30s.
reset_and_credit.phase_three_death: Monstrosity JustDied calls ACTION_FINISH_ENCOUNTER; controller removes player helper auras and sets DATA_ASCENDANT_COUNCIL DONE.
reset_and_credit.instance_mapping: DATA_ASCENDANT_COUNCIL is encounter index 2; boss IDs 43686, 43687, 43688, 43689 and 43735 are mapped in instance data; doors are 205226/205227.
reset_and_credit.retail_credit: Retail lockout, loot, achievement, and reset semantics are not asserted from repository behavior.
